title: IndoCulture: Exploring Geographically-Influenced Cultural Commonsense Reasoning Across Eleven Indonesian Provinces
benchmark_measurement: Knowledge of cultural commonsense related to religious holidays and socio-religious aspects of life in Indonesia.
findings: Top-performing models like GPT-4 and Llama-3 demonstrated strong capabilities on religion-related cultural topics. For province-specific contexts, GPT-4 achieved 78.6% accuracy on 'Religious holidays', while Llama-3 scored 71.8% on 'Socio-religious aspects'. Performance was notably higher for non-province-specific contexts, where scores for these topics reached 91.5% for GPT-4 and 88.5% for Llama-3, respectively.
